notes.title: Quick bug fix
notes.content: There was a bug while fetching your rank on the leaderboards. The text was stuck in "Loading...".

notes.title: Difficulty tweaks, mouse cursor and Steam overlay
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

Here we are with another update for the game!!

- NEW: When you beat a level and unlock the next one, it will be selected by default.
- NEW: The mouse cursor is now hidden while playing.
- NEW: The game will pause when the Steam overlay is activated.
- FIX: Some difficulty tweaks for levels 1-2 and 1-4.

We're hard at work with World 7, almost finishing the game.

Thanks a lot for your support and keep playing!!

notes.title: Change Game Settings from Pause Menu!
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

This is a quick update. Now you'll be able to open the game settings directly from the Pause Menu.

 Set volume, toggle music and sound effects.
 Change resolution
 Switch language


Thanks a lot for playing, and stay tuned!

notes.title: More time and collectibles improvements!!
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

We have very important updates today:

 500 seconds for all levels: Complete levels at your pace, take your time, get everything.
 Reworked collectibles: Previously, if you repeated a level, you needed to search for all collectibles again to get 3 stars. Not anymore! From now on, just focus on missing collectibles and you will be rewarded at the end.

That's it for now! We've been really hard at work with World 6 and we hope to share more details soon.

Thanks for supporting us!

- José

notes.title: Cloud Saves Fix - Get the latest update!
notes.content:
Hello!

The demo had an issue with Cloud Saves. It seems that Steam didn't recognize the format of the save files. So, in this update:

 Reworked Save / Load System
 Fixed Steam Cloud Saves


Make sure you have the latest update installed. Now available for both Windows and Mac.

Thanks for your support!!
